milestones.title: Shop foundation and trust
milestones.description: Turn the existing demo shop into a trustworthy foundation without representing sample data as live commerce.

milestones.title: Real commerce
milestones.description: Build server-authoritative ordering, inventory and Iranian payment verification before accepting real payments.

milestones.title: Office fulfillment and after-sales
milestones.description: Establish evidence-based shipping, pickup, testing, warranty and returns operations.

milestones.title: Evidence-based AI assistance
milestones.description: Add consented label extraction and deterministic compatibility checks without inventing technical facts.

milestones.title: Sustainable growth
milestones.description: Expand from verified retail fulfillment to B2B assessment and privacy-conscious unit economics.

milestones.title: Protocol correctness
milestones.description: Complete unresolved market, oracle, settlement, governance and dispute invariants before production financial use.

issues.title: Replace demo catalog with verified inventory and compatibility data
issues.body:
## Goal
Replace illustrative products with supplier-verified SKUs.

## Acceptance criteria
- Every SKU records model, source, verification date, price validity, nominal Wh, voltage/current, connector and polarity where relevant.
- Output/PD profiles, warranty provider and evidence are explicit.
- Unknown data stays unknown; reviews, stock and warranties are never fabricated.
- Start with modem/router UPS, compatible power banks, lighting and accessories; treat large stations as quote-only until supply is verified.

issues.title: Deliver a Persian responsive storefront without wallet dependency
issues.body:
## Goal
Make the customer shop understandable and usable independently of the protocol dashboard.

## Acceptance criteria
- Persian RTL catalog, cart and form flows with accessible labels and keyboard use.
- Mobile layouts are verified manually.
- Retail browsing and cart use do not require a wallet.
- Protocol routes remain available without forcing blockchain concepts into retail checkout.

issues.title: Implement server-authoritative orders and inventory reservations
issues.body:
## Goal
Prevent stale prices, overselling and duplicate orders before real sales.

## Acceptance criteria
- Server computes totals using integer money amounts.
- Inventory reservations expire and release on cancellation or payment failure.
- Reservation/decrement transitions are atomic and order creation is idempotent.
- Order status changes and administration are access-controlled.
- Replacement cost, supplier availability timestamp and quote expiry are recorded.

issues.title: Integrate Iranian payment verification with currency-safe accounting
issues.body:
## Goal
Accept payments only after verifiable server-side confirmation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Toman display and rial gateway conversion are explicit and tested.
- Gateway callback verifies merchant reference, amount and success server-side.
- Replayed callbacks cannot double-fulfill.
- Failed or canceled payments release reservations.
- Refund and reconciliation workflow is documented and tested.
- Provider credentials never enter browser bundles or logs.

issues.title: Add guest checkout, receipts and protected order tracking
issues.body:
## Goal
Support real retail customers without blockchain account requirements.

## Acceptance criteria
- Phone/address validation and minimal personal-data collection.
- Guest tracking uses appropriate access controls.
- Receipts show real order state rather than simulated checkout.
- Wallet linking is optional and never required.
- Retention and privacy obligations are reviewed before launch.

issues.title: Verify battery shipping eligibility and office pickup operations
issues.body:
## Goal
Ship only products accepted by carriers under documented handling requirements.

## Acceptance criteria
- Carrier confirms battery restrictions for each supported SKU and route.
- Packaging, labels, dispatch cutoff and pricing are documented.
- Unsupported shipping combinations are blocked.
- Pickup address and hours are published only after approval.

Being near a post office is not evidence that a battery shipment will be accepted.

issues.title: Record serials, bench tests, warranty and returns evidence
issues.body:
## Goal
Make after-sales claims auditable and truthful.

## Acceptance criteria
- Serial number and condition are captured before dispatch.
- Switching/runtime tests record load, method, date and measured result.
- Warranty and return terms match supplier evidence.
- Support tickets link to the order and serial with restricted access.

issues.title: Track supplier risk and inventory unit economics
issues.body:
## Goal
Protect replenishment capacity during price volatility.

## Acceptance criteria
- Replacement cost, packing/shipping, fees, acquisition cost, return reserve and contribution margin are separate fields.
- Reorder thresholds and stock age are reported.
- Business inventory funding is separated from personal savings.
- No margin or revenue guarantee is presented.

issues.title: Extract device labels with consent and human confirmation
issues.body:
## Goal
Use AI to reduce transcription effort without making unsourced electrical claims.

## Acceptance criteria
- Users consent before label-image processing.
- Extracted model, voltage, current and polarity show source and confidence.
- Users confirm extracted values; uncertain labels require manual entry.
- Uploaded images are retained only as long as necessary.

issues.title: Build deterministic compatibility rules with AI explanations
issues.body:
## Goal
Give safe recommendations based on verified electrical constraints.

## Acceptance criteria
- Voltage, polarity, connector, PD profile and output-power rules determine compatibility.
- Missing data blocks definitive recommendations.
- AI explains sourced rule results but cannot invent stock, specifications or safe connections.
- Measured runtime evidence is preferred; estimates display assumptions.
- Incompatible and incomplete-data cases are tested.

issues.title: Offer opt-in B2B backup assessments and installation referrals
issues.body:
## Goal
Extend verified retail operations to businesses without unsafe installation promises.

## Acceptance criteria
- Office/shop load survey is opt-in.
- Quotes state assumptions and expiry.
- Approved installation partners have clear handoff, responsibility and warranty boundaries.
- No unsafe DIY mains advice is provided.

issues.title: Report privacy-conscious retail conversion and unit economics
issues.body:
## Goal
Measure whether the shop is sustainable without treating demo events as sales.

## Acceptance criteria
- Browsing, quotes, paid orders, delivery, returns and net contribution are distinct.
- Demo records are excluded.
- Acquisition spend and replacement-cost margin are visible.
- Reporting is aggregated and minimizes personal identifiers.

issues.title: Release unfilled market collateral safely
issues.body:
## Goal
Ensure unfilled buyer payment and seller energy are recoverable under explicit auction lifecycle rules.

## Acceptance criteria
- Release paths preserve filled obligations and prevent double release.
- Authorization and lifecycle conditions are tested.
- Regression tests cover no fills, partial fills, repeated calls and invalid slots.

issues.title: Implement and verify actual uniform-price clearing
issues.body:
## Goal
Align auction pricing, transfers and reported settlement amounts.

## Acceptance criteria
- All matched positions use the defined clearing-price rule.
- Market transfers and settlement records agree.
- Tests cover multiple bid prices and partial fills.
- Economic invariants are documented and independently reviewed.

issues.title: Require consistent multi-oracle production reports
issues.body:
## Goal
Require agreement on reported production data, not only reporter count.

## Acceptance criteria
- Consensus compares report content under a documented aggregation rule.
- Conflicts, late reports and quorum failure are handled explicitly.
- Tests cover divergent reports and finalization boundaries.

issues.title: Make governance execution change protected protocol state
issues.body:
## Goal
Ensure approved governance decisions execute their intended parameter changes safely.

## Acceptance criteria
- Proposals map to authorized, validated state changes.
- Timelock/role constraints are enforced.
- Tests prove proposal execution changes the intended parameter and rejects invalid actions.

issues.title: Define authorized dispute workflow and resolution effects
issues.body:
## Goal
Prevent unauthorized or ambiguous dispute outcomes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Eligible parties, evidence windows and resolution authority are defined.
- Resolution effects on settlement and stakes are explicit.
- Tests cover unauthorized calls, expiry and conflicting resolutions.
